description.name: Basic Attack: Robin Attack
description.desc:
Press  to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks forward, dealing Ether DMG;

description.name: Dodge: Robin Dodge
description.desc:
Press  to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Dash Attack: Robin Dash
description.desc:
Press  during a dodge to activate:
Perform an attack forward, dealing Ether DMG.

description.name: Entry Skill: Robin Entrance
description.desc:
When at 100 or more [Entry Points], switching this character on field or holding  consumes 100 [Entry Points] to activate:
Unleashes an Energy blast at enemies in front, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Activating this skill counts as activating a [Quick Assist].
Provides all squad members with a [Robin Shield] equal to 4% of this character's initial Max HP, lasting 20s.

description.name: Quick Assist: Robin Assist
description.desc:
When the active character is launched, press  to activate:
Swing the staff to attack enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Special Attack: Robin Exit
description.desc:
Press  to activate:
Leaps high into the air and unleashes an Energy Blast around her, dealing massive Ether DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After activation, triggers a Quick Assist. After switching out, Robin enters the [Off-Field Guard] state for 60s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. Also grants all squad members a [Robin Shield] equal to 2% of Robin's initial Max HP, lasting 15s.

description.name: Special Attack: Aftershock
EX Special Attack: Enhanced Aftershock
Chain Attack: Robin Finale
description.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful series of attacks forward, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Ultimate: Robin Crescendo
description.desc:
When the Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press  to activate:
Unleashes a powerful series of attacks forward, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Core Passive:
description.desc:
When Robin uses certain skills, she grants all squad members a [Robin Shield] equal to a set percentage of her initial Max HP, lasting 15s. When a character gains [Robin Shield] again, the shield value stacks and its duration is extended, up to a maximum of 60s. The shield value cannot exceed 8% of Robin's initial Max HP.
Each time a squad member gains [Robin Shield], their DMG is increased by 25% for 15s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.

description.name: Additional Ability:
description.desc:
Triggers when another character in your squad is an [Armorer] or [Stun] Character:
Upon entering the battlefield, gain 1 [Buff Enhance Point]. In Domain Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.

1.desc: Each time Robin consumes [Enhance Buff Points], all squad members gain 20% Laceration DMG for 60s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When consuming [Enhance Buff Points], Robin gains 1 stack of [Feather Defense]. When the on-field character takes DMG, Robin consumes 1 stack of [Feather Defense] to make them briefly Invulnerable.

2.name: PlaceHolder
2.desc: When Robin triggers an [Aftershock], DMG dealt by all squad members ignores 12% of the enemy's RES for 15s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. Squad members with [Robin Shield] gain increased Anti-Interrupt level.
